rows.description: The rows of nested components. There must be at least one row and each row must have at least one column.

divided.description:
Whether there is a dividing line between the cells:
 - `vertical` dividing lines between rows only
 - `horizontal` dividing lines between columns only
 - `internal` dividing lines between both rows and columns
 - `celled` dividing lines between rows and columns and around outside

title:
This component arranges a set of other components into a grid. There can be up to sixteen columns in each row and an
unlimited number of rows.

If the rows have different number of columns, the rows with fewer columns will widen them. A weight may be specified
on columns and the extra space will be apportioned in relation to the width. If widths are unspecified, the space
will be divided equally (within the constraint of a fixed number of underlying columns).
name: GridLayout
